newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: European feeds remain slow in afternoon.
newsitem.headline: European feeds remain slow in afternoon.

text.p: Business on the European meals and feeds market remained slow this afternoon as operators here stayed sidelined, expecting a weaker Chicago soycomplex futures opening after USDA raised the U.S. 1996/97 ending stocks by five million bushels to 130 million bushels, market sources said.
"There was no action at all in soymeal today and we saw a bit of a sell-off in Argentine sunmeal pellets on calls Chicago futures would ease on the USDA crop figures," one broker said.
Nearby afloat Argentine sunmeal pellets traded at $123 a tonne cif Rotterdam, July/Sept at $126, after trading at $128 early in the day, and Oct/Dec at $130 a tonne cif.
